passages.provision_quote: The department shall identify and compile relevant educational materials and information for health care professionals and patients regarding maternal mental health conditions
passages.note: Enacted text directs the department to compile and distribute maternal mental health materials and creates a rural obstetrics advisory committee that reports by December 31, 2026.

rows.reasoning: The only record on file is HB2332 (2025), which Willoughby prime-sponsored and voted Y on, and which directs the health department to compile and distribute maternal mental health educational materials and establishes an advisory committee on rural obstetrics. The ladder orders whom government covers or helps pay for, and this instrument neither covers anyone nor expands a program, so it cannot reach rung 3's "Help people who can't afford care and expand programs for seniors and low-income residents" or any other rung; the annex treats health information as not access. No passage survives V2, so no evidence remains.
